title: Account-Standing Schedule for the Basis-Month Eligibility Credit
content:
**Schedule.** On a Pre-K tuition account of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the basis-month eligibility credit has an amount added when the tuition account shows arrears on the day the credit is posted.

The whole months of arrears are the enrollment's tuition charges and late fees less its payments, divided by the most recent billing month's tuition charge and rounded down to a whole number. Credits are not payments and are not subtracted.

| Whole months of arrears on the day the credit is posted | Added to the credit |
|---|---|
| three or more | 7.50 |
| two | 5.00 |
| one or none | nothing |

## Worked cases (hypothetical enrollment, most recent tuition charge 450.00)

| Charges and late fees to date | Payments to date | Arrears divided by 450.00 | Whole months | Added |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2,300.00 | 900.00 | 3.11 | 3 | 7.50 |
| 2,300.00 | 1,200.00 | 2.44 | 2 | 5.00 |
| 2,300.00 | 1,500.00 | 1.78 | 1 | nothing |
